reviews.review:
Despite my playtime being significantly less than most of the reviews you see on this page, I can say that Deep Rock Galactic is absolutely, without a doubt, my new favorite go-to multiplayer title in the brief time that I've owned it. 

If you like cooperative shooters in the vein of Left 4 Dead, Payday 2 and Vermintide then I cannot stress enough that DRG should be considered an essential addition to your library; it's even great solo! 

It's extremely charming, gorgeous, and mechanically rock solid and I've gotten my brother and several of my friends hooked.  The upgrade system is fairly robust and yet not convoluted, encounters are stressful and intense, yet never to the point of being frustrating; really the best way to describe this game is just by saying it's damn fun. 

Each class is incredibly unique and feel fantastic to use, and the way the synergize together is practically unmatched in the genre. There's something so satisfying about having your team's gunner watch your back while you as the driller dig a shortcut to the drop pod, or to have an engineer make a platform for the team scout to perch upon to get that hard to reach mineral. 

I don't think I can just say "this game is seriously one of the best multiplayer games I've played in years" enough times. It's 30 bucks, just do it.

I can not recommend this game due to the attitude towards balancing the game the dev team has. (I would leave a neutral review if i could)

They take the approach of nerfing weapons/perks/etc based on popularity rather than strength. This means some choices are and stay better than everything else but leaving weapons and upgrades that need fixing in terrible states. This might sound strange but (anecdotal example incoming) Gunner whose name would suggest one of the better/best classes at damaging and killing enemies is unironically the worst. 2 of his 3 main weapons are under powered but because people will still pick them often enough (despite them being weak) the devs change nothing. This often leads to you and the other team members having to pick up the gunners slack. (such examples exist for every dwarf with some weapon choices being awful so the problem isn't limited to Gunner)

All of that said, the devs do work hard to add new things to the game and keep the code free of bugs (the only type of bug allowed in this game is the type that tries to eat you) so its not a bad game, it just could be better.
Awesome game !!! They frequently update the game and the devs are always active. If you like first person shooters then this is your game.

Unique mining game, not too hard to understand and play.  Raise your levels to make it harder.  Better with friends than solo on this one, but you have a robot companion when you do go solo to help you out.  Very likable game.

Fun little game to play with your friends, kill some time. (COVID-19 quarantine review)

Pros:- Cartoonie-like graphix. (which I personally apreciate)
- The procedurally generated levels and maps are good-looking, you almost wouldn't think it's Random generated.
- The 4 classes are different to each other, their uniqueness fills the gameplay and they kinda complete each other in the tasks that are given to you. (Supposing you have 3 other friends)
- Frequent updates and bug-fix patches.

Overall, the devs have done a great job!

Cons:- The current price, which is 27,99€. (even doe I bought It at 13,99€)
- Can get a little bit grindy and repetitive.
- EARLY ACCESS.
